answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own forge record, and its own share of the copper quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The wander ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 4 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 3092 identities would post 3027 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
